breaking.member: UI document scoped CSS (the root element's auto width)
breaking.change: A document's root element with width: auto now fills the column or stack it is mounted in, as CSS's root block fills the initial containing block, instead of shrinking to fit its content. A wider child's min-content no longer widens the whole document past the viewport, so max-width: 100% and aspect-ratio below it hold to the viewport (a 640px card with max-width: 100% in a 16px-padded root at a 390 viewport is 358×201, not 640×360).
breaking.fix: Where a component should size to its content, give its root element `width: fit-content`.
